title: Modern Condo Escape, Near Attractions, Pool Access
description:
Illume 223

The space
Set the tone for a lively trip to Music City with a stay at this vibrant second-floor condo. You'll be within a mile and a half of some of Nashville's hottest attractions with a seasonal on-site pool for even more fun. Fitness-minded folks will appreciate the shared fitness room, so they don't have to pause their regular workout routines.

Sit outside on the private covered balcony overlooking the pool to enjoy a cool breeze. Enjoy homecooked meals at the breakfast bar with seating for four.

Inside you'll find colorful accent walls, contemporary furnishings, and one-of-a-kind decor. The open-concept space includes a roomy full kitchen where you can prepare meals using stainless steel appliances. 

Other creature comforts include Sonos speakers, three smart TVs, a lighted makeup mirror, entral AC, and a private washer/dryer.

Shared Amenitites
・Outdoor swimming pool (open seasonally)
・Furnished pool deck with gas grill
・Private landscaped courtyard
・Fitness center
・Public Wi-Fi at pool
・Lounge
・Two secured elevators
・On-site overnight security

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
